doc.method_javadoc:
/**
     * For this distribution, {@code X}, this method returns {@code P(X < x)}.
     * If {@code x}is more than 40 standard deviations from the mean, 0 or 1 is returned,
     * as in these cases the actual value is within {@code Double.MIN_VALUE} of 0 or 1.
     *
     * @param x Value at which the CDF is evaluated.
     * @return CDF evaluated at {@code x}.
     * @throws MathException if the algorithm fails to converge
     */

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Return the absolute accuracy setting of the solver used to estimate
     * inverse cumulative probabilities.
     *
     * @return the solver absolute accuracy.
     * @since 2.1
     */
siblings.name: getSolverAbsoluteAccuracy

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * For this distribution, X, this method returns the critical point
     * {@code x}, such that {@code P(X < x) = p}.
     * It will return {@code Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY} when p = 0 and
     * {@code Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY} for p = 1.
     *
     * @param p Desired probability.
     * @return {@code x}, such that {@code P(X < x) = p}.
     * @throws MathException if the inverse cumulative probability cannot be
     * computed due to convergence or other numerical errors.
     * @throws org.apache.commons.math.exception.OutOfRangeException if
     * {@code p} is not a valid probability.
     */
siblings.name: inverseCumulativeProbability

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Generate a random value sampled from this distribution.
     *
     * @return a random value.
     * @since 2.2
     * @throws MathException if an error occurs generating the random value.
     */
siblings.name: sample

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Access the domain value lower bound, based on {@code p}, used to
     * bracket a CDF root.  This method is used by
     * {@link #inverseCumulativeProbability(double)} to find critical values.
     *
     * @param p Desired probability for the critical value.
     * @return the domain value lower bound, i.e. {@code P(X < 'lower bound') < p}.
     */
siblings.name: getDomainLowerBound

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Access the domain value upper bound, based on {@code p}, used to
     * bracket a CDF root.  This method is used by
     * {@link #inverseCumulativeProbability(double)} to find critical values.
     *
     * @param p Desired probability for the critical value.
     * @return the domain value upper bound, i.e. {@code P(X < 'upper bound') > p}.
     */
siblings.name: getDomainUpperBound

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Access the initial domain value, based on {@code p}, used to
     * bracket a CDF root.  This method is used by
     * {@link #inverseCumulativeProbability(double)} to find critical values.
     *
     * @param p Desired probability for the critical value.
     * @return the initial domain value.
     */
siblings.name: getInitialDomain

sig.class_declaration: public class NormalDistributionImpl extends AbstractContinuousDistribution implements NormalDistribution, Serializable
constructors: public NormalDistributionImpl(double mean, double sd, double inverseCumAccuracy);
sig.focal_signature: public double cumulativeProbability(double x) throws MathException
methods: public double inverseCumulativeProbability(final double p) throws MathException;
